'''Yoko''' (Japanese: '''ヨウコ''' ''Yōko'') is [[Gardenia]]'s assistant and a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[DP037|The Grass Menagerie!]]''. 

She greeted {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} as they arrived at the [[Eterna Gym]]. Yoko later refereed the [[Gym]] {{pkmn|battle}} between Gardenia and {{Ash}}.
